# Filter King

> Filter King is a leading HVAC and furnace filter retailer offering 1000+ stocked air filter sizes with free shipping across the United States.

Filter King specializes in residential and commercial HVAC solutions, providing US-made pleated filters with various MERV ratings for AC and furnace systems. The company serves both individual customers and B2B clients with bulk ordering capabilities.

## Key Topics

- HVAC filters

- AC filters
